newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B shares edge higher in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares edge higher in slow trade.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index closed slightly higher in slow trade on Friday as market sentiment was somewhat helped by institutional buying of a handful of large-cap counters with solid earnings records, analysts said.
The B share index edged up 0.42 points, or 0.47 percent, to end at 90.25, with turnover contracting to HK$11.90 million from HK$23.46 million on Thursday.
Despite the gain, the index should test the 90-point support level again next week given Friday's light turnover, said an analyst for the China Southern Securities.
Barring any big market-moving news, the index will fluctuate in a narrow range around that level for some time, he added.

Zhonghao was the star with an advance of HK$0.14, or 8.70 percent, to HK$1.75 on paper-thin trading of 100 shares. Shenzhen Petrochemical rose HK$0.14, or 5.96 percent, to HK$2.49, with 14,000 shares changing hands.

Textile issue Victor Onward rose HK$0.08 to HK$1.71 and Lionda climbed HK$0.10 to HK$2.30. Washing machine maker Little Swan was aided by institutional demand, analysts said. It jumped HK$0.05 to HK$5.30 with the day's heaviest volume of 449,100 shares.

Guangdong Expressway gained HK$0.15, or 3.23 percent, to HK$4.80 on volume of 267,700 shares. Lizhu Pharmaceutical bucked the trend with the day's sharpest fall of HK$0.42 to HK$2.61 after 101,100 shares were traded. Analysts provided no explanation for the counter's drop.
The A share market gained marginally on Friday due in part to speculative buying of a group of third-liners that had reported very poor 1996 interim results, brokers said.
The A share index edged up 1.46 points, or 0.51 percent, to close at 289.77 on turnover of 6.36 billion yuan, compared with 6.77 billion yuan of the previous session.
The composite index rose 1.37 points, or 0.50 percent, to finish at 273.04.
Qinghai Celluloid Co Ltd, which listed 13.5 million class A shares in Shenzhen on Friday, ended at 8.22 yuan against its recent offer price of 4.30 yuan per share.
Real estate developer Hainan Pearl River surged 1.03 yuan, or 18.90 percent, to 6.48 yuan. Chemical fibre maker Kunshan Sanshan advanced 0.51 yuan, or 13.64 percent, to 4.25 yuan.
